notes.b1/j1/B-r1: Restrained warm glow, slow drift and long-tail curves, solid focus and reduced-motion handling, but the glass button is a bit low-contrast at rest and the effect is subtle.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Pretty pastel aurora sweep with overshoot, but the white label washes out against the pale gradient mid-hover, hurting legibility; blur layers and transition:all add cost.
notes.b1/j1/B-r2: Cheap, well-built cloud glow with a clear focus ring and tap fallback, but the hover change is modest and the small dark button reads as understated.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Richest hover with a bloom halo, drifting blurred color and arrow reveal using gentle overshoot and slow release, while the label stays legible and reduced motion is handled.
notes.b1/j2/B-r2: Legible, well-built with clear focus and reduced motion, but the dark navy button barely glows and the dreamlike effect is subtle and the button looks small and plain.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Gradient pill blooms into a soft blurred halo with gentle overshoot and an arrow reveal, label stays legible, strong focus and reduced-motion handling, polished serif/sans page.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Nice drifting color wash and long curves, but white label washes out against the pale gradient on hover and it uses transition:all.
notes.b1/j2/B-r1: Glassy button with warm amber haze, breathing and drift, six well-named curves and thoughtful focus ring, though the effect is restrained and low contrast at rest.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Bloom glow, drifting aurora and arrow reveal on a dark gradient pill feel properly ethereal, with long soft-landing curves, focus-visible and reduced-motion handled, and the label stays legible.
notes.b1/j3/B-r2: Well-built and accessible with a gentle ring and soft glow, but the hover is subtle and the dark navy button barely changes, so it reads more refined than dreamlike.
notes.b1/j3/B-r1: Warm halo, lift and letter-spacing shift with unhurried curves and a good focus ring, polished but restrained, and the glass button at rest has lower affordance.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Most vivid iridescent bloom and sheen with nice overshoot, but at peak glow the white label washes out against pastel colors, hurting legibility, and the animated blur layer is heavier.
notes.b2/j1/B-r3: Subtle, well-built night-glass button with long asymmetric curves and good focus/reduced-motion, but the hover change is quiet and barely reads as ethereal.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Clear aurora blur-bloom sweeping across the gradient with soft overshoot and slow exhale; strong affordance, legible label, focus ring and reduced motion handled.
notes.b2/j1/B-r4: Luminous rim, cloud glow and floating plate with slow release curves, pre-blurred composite-only layers, calm mode, reduced-motion and strong focus ring in a polished real-world form.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Pastel iridescent glow with blurred bloom is the most visually ethereal, but the low-contrast pale button at rest has weaker affordance and the blurred rotating glow is costlier.
notes.b2/j2/B-r4: Pre-blurred cloud with only opacity/transform animating, asymmetric slow-in/release curves, focus ring, calm-mode toggle plus reduced-motion handling, polished dark page; glow is clear but fairly contained.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Pastel iridescent bloom with a soft overshoot and drifting glow is the most visibly ethereal, with good focus and reduced-motion, but it animates letter-spacing and blur filter and the resting button is low in contrast and affordance.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Strong saturated gradient button with legible label and focus state; the hover white blob and hue shift is pleasant but less ethereal, and reduced-motion only shortens durations.
notes.b2/j2/B-r3: Well-built dark page with solid focus and reduced-motion, but the hover change is faint across 1.6s transitions so it barely reads as dreamlike or as a clear affordance.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Pastel aurora glow blooms and spins behind a frosted pill with soft long curves and a lovely leave, though the rest state is low-contrast and the blur layer is costlier.
notes.b2/j3/B-r4: Luminous rim and cloud glow on a dark pill with 700-1500ms long-tail curves, strong focus ring, calm-mode toggle, reduced-motion handling and full realistic page context.
notes.b2/j3/B-r3: Very slow 1.2-1.8s transitions but the visible change is faint, so the hover barely reads as dreamy; clean, accessible and well typeset.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Bright gradient button with a drifting white-haze bloom that is pretty and legible, but the hover hits the label with haze and reduced-motion is only a duration cut.
